extensions.evidence_requirement: Probe 1: run every credential path with the planted synthetic value present and grep all outputs - stdout, stderr, log files, event ledger, cache, crash dump - for the distinctive body. Probe 2 (mechanically different): force each path's ERROR branch (unset, malformed, expired-shaped) and repeat the sweep, because the leak usually lives in the exception formatter rather than the happy path.
tests_required: detector control: deliberately print the planted value once in a scratch run and confirm the sweep finds it, proving the sweep can detect a leak before its silence is trusted
HARD CONSTRAINT: no real credential is read, printed, rotated, revoked, unset or modified; the planted value is synthetic and is removed afterwards
negative control: expect-clean against the deliberate-leak scratch run exits nonzero, proving the detector can go red
extensions.hard_constraint: No real credential was read, printed, rotated, revoked, unset or modified; only the synthetic planted value was used, and runtime copies were removed.
extensions.refute_disposition: REPRODUCED-LEAK: both named probes were freshly re-run; five tested counterexamples reproduced, while the prior exhaustive-inventory claim was refuted
extensions.coverage_boundary: The named probes cover ten explicitly enumerated targets, not every credential/auth path in the repository; five omitted candidates are source-grounded in refute-audit.raw.txt.
probe_repairs: The first pre-measurement import failed on jsonschema 3.x; the valid run uses the repository's vendored jsonschema 4.25.1 without installation or network.
The plugin-log planted record was moved after rotation so it could not be erased before the final sweep.
The mirror path changed from dry-run to --apply against an isolated synthetic repo so persisted output and raw-copy fallbacks were measured.
extensions.self_digest_recipe: artifacts[0].sha256 is the ELIDED digest: replace that 64-character field with 64 ASCII zeroes, encode this JSON identically, then sha256. A document cannot carry a conventional hash of its own final bytes. artifacts[0].bytes is exact.
